diego (new-dev): Hey folks, trying the quickstart through an SSH tunnel to the private API (we're on-prem eval). First call returns HTTP 402 with body: `{\"error\":\"billing_required\",\"detail\":\"workspace needs payment method\"}`. I thought eval orgs were allowed.

sara (devex): Welcome! Which quickstart and SDK? Also are you hitting a private deployment URL or hosted?

diego (new-dev): Using node quickstart from examples/tunnel, pointing to https://private.redwood.local via `ssh -L 8443:private.redwood.local:443 jumpbox` and curl to localhost:8443/v1/chat. SDK v0.10.1 inside the container.

owen (sdk-eng): Two things: 1) SDK will surface 402 as billing_required; we recently tightened the error message so it's explicit (v0.10.0+). 2) For private evals we enable a sandbox flag on the workspace; if the flag isn't set the server will treat it like a paid endpoint and return billing_required.

diego (new-dev): How do I check that sandbox flag? The onboarding UI was a bit different for private deployments and I might have skipped a step.

mira (billing-cs): I checked your org `diego-onprem-eval` and status is "Pending billing: payment method required". For private evals we normally auto-enable sandbox on request to the solutions team. I can flip it for you if you DM the org id.

diego (new-dev): Hmm I did request access but maybe it didn't propagate. I also noticed the quickstart sample uses `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env but the container image we used expects `RW_KEY` (legacy). Could that cause a different flow? Logs show `authorization header absent` then billing_required.

owen (sdk-eng): If the auth header is missing some private endpoints fall back to an identity check that triggers billing gating. Two quick patches: 1) we'll update the tunnel quickstart README to call out the env mismatch, 2) add an explicit diagnostic in the SDK to print "No API key found, ensure REDWOOD_API_KEY is set or mount secret" when running in container/tunnel mode.

sara (devex): I'll open a docs PR for examples/tunnel with a step: "If using SSH tunnel, confirm REDWOOD_API_KEY present inside container and request sandbox enable for private evals."

tunnel-bot: Auto: Created ticket SBOX-141 for solutions to enable sandbox for diego-onprem-eval.

mira (billing-cs): Sandbox enabled for 24h for your org. Also sent a note with steps to attach a payment method to avoid interruptions after the eval.

diego (new-dev): Rebuilt container with REDWOOD_API_KEY set and retried via tunnel; first call now returns 200. Thanks all. Learned two things: (1) private evals need explicit sandbox enable, (2) env var names can diverge between sample images and docs. Logging this thread for future tunnel users. :rocket:
__notes: Slack thread with short messages; messages are chronological and prefixed by sender names per agents.md.
